task.description:
Design artefact for REQ-036 (Promotion plan computation, conflict preflight, and plan digest -- promotion_plan.zig PRM-01 + promotion_conflict.zig PRM-02 + promotion_digest.zig PRM-03). Read REQ-036's full entry in docs/requirements.yaml (currently branch feature/WF02-REQ036-20260817 is checked out) before starting -- it names the exact three modules/functions and their behaviour in detail. Also read docs/guides/backend_developer_guide.md, docs/migration/stage-2-event-store-definitions.md, and any docs/migration/decisions/ file relevant to permissions/role-checks (REQ-036 needs a promotion.submit-equivalent permission check against REQ-020's TenantRole model -- flag explicitly in the design if it doesn't map cleanly rather than inventing a new permission mechanism). This is domain logic only -- no HTTP/Plug layer (that's S4 scope).

Produce lib/letflow/design/promotion_plan.md covering:
1. Letflow.Definitions.PromotionPlan module: compute_promotion_plan/5(actor_id, source_tenant_id, target_tenant_id, process_key, opts \\ []) -- full @spec-style signature, PlanEntry/PromotionPlan struct shapes ({type, id, change_kind, before, after}), the 5-dimension diff (graph nodes/edges by id, variable_schema, service-catalog bindings as raw service_id string diff on SERVICE_TASK nodes, module_ref VALUES as raw string diff on SUB_PROCESS nodes), error cases (forbidden, invalid-promotion-source, empty-plan) as explicit {:error, atom} or {:error, {atom, detail}} tags -- state exactly which.
2. Letflow.Definitions.PromotionConflict module: reject_if_conflicts/4(actor_id, target_tenant_id, process_key, base_version) -- plain read (no FOR UPDATE), conflict = target_active_version > base_version, rejection detail shape naming each conflicting definition (supports multiple process_key conflicts as a list per prm-02's Open question 2).
3. Letflow.Definitions.PromotionDigest module: compute_plan_digest/1(plan) -- SHA-256 over canonical JSON (explicit key-sorting step -- name exactly how, e.g. a recursive sort-then-encode helper, since Jason does not guarantee key order), returns 64-char lowercase hex; verify_digest/2(digest, plan_or_digest) -- constant-time compare, name the exact function used (:crypto.hash_equals/2 or equivalent) and state this choice in the moduledoc per the acceptance criteria.

For each of the 6 acceptance criteria in REQ-036, map it to a concrete design element -- no TBDs. List open questions explicitly (e.g. the promotion.submit permission mapping) rather than silently resolving them. No implementation code (.ex bodies) -- signatures, types, and behaviour description only.
acceptance_criteria: Every one of REQ-036's 6 acceptance criteria maps to a concrete design element in lib/letflow/design/promotion_plan.md
All 3 modules' public function signatures fully specified with @spec-style types and explicit error-tuple shapes
DB access pattern for reject_if_conflicts/4 explicitly states 'no lock / plain read' per PRM-02
Canonical-JSON key-sorting approach for compute_plan_digest/1 explicitly named, not left implicit
Constant-time comparison function for verify_digest/2 explicitly named
promotion.submit-equivalent permission check against REQ-020's TenantRole model addressed or flagged as an open question, not silently invented
No implementation code present -- signatures and type shapes only
